caption: The video captures a close-up of a spherical object mounted on a short stick, its surface draped in a thick, glossy coating of green and blue fluid. A band of bright yellow runs along the left side, blending into the cooler colors, while a darker blue seam curves near the right edge. The coating is already moving, and it continues to shift slowly throughout. Tiny bubbles cluster across the upper green region, their arrangement changing almost imperceptibly as the viscous layer shifts slowly and faintly downward. The boundary where the green meets the yellow shows only faint nudges, without a clear advance over the yellow band. A dark teal crescent remains fixed on the left, while a thin filament of green drips from the lower right edge, holding its shape with only marginal change. The stick descends toward a blurred light-brown surface against a dark, out-of-focus background. The slow ooze of the coating persists without reaching any settled state.
